name: LIQUEN + MAFALDA
description: LIQUEN and MAFALDA are performing a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 7, 2026, starting at 10 PM.
longDescription:
LIQUEN and MAFALDA will perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is set for November 7, 2026, with a start time of 10 PM. The concert has an estimated duration of 120 minutes.

Tickets are priced at 8€ for general admission. If purchased at the door, the price is 10€. The event is open to individuals aged 16 and older.

Radioclube Agramonte is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto. The promoter for this event is Radioclube Agramonte.
